description: Ed25519 admissibility vectors for APS. expected_verification is the accept or reject that the two strict reference implementations were OBSERVED to agree on: libsodium through PyNaCl (agent-passport-python src/agent_passport/crypto.py) and ed25519-dalek verify_strict (agent-passport-system crates/aps-verifier-core). It records their observable answer, not a claim about how either one reaches it; the two do not implement the same internal checks. Agreement was established over a corpus that also contains the Wycheproof Ed25519 suite, and the two disagreed on nothing. A public key or an R whose decoded point has small order, and a scalar s that is not reduced modulo L, are inadmissible. The small_order_A_full_order_R group isolates the test on the public key: R there is a full order, canonically encoded point and s < L, so only a small order test on A refuses the signature. The small_order_R_honest_key group isolates the test on R in the same way.
